community_exact_match_search.result: No exact maker/model assets in the 198-entry ChemLab catalogue; Eppendorf 5910 Ri is a different machine and was not reused.

mesh_edit_policy: New procedural mesh datablocks only. No existing/source mesh modified. Rebuild from recipe; source files retained. Save unified library snapshot before any later existing mesh edits.

dimension_evidence.document: Optima XE manual B07711AA, physical data; Optima XPN manufacturer catalogue A94469
dimension_evidence.original_wdh: 94.0 cm W x 68.1 cm D x 125.7 cm H
dimension_evidence.uncertainty: Nominal manufacturer envelope. XE and XPN really share the chassis and same dimensions, confirmed in manufacturer Optima X series specification table. Panel curves, door travel, chamber and rotor dimensions inferred. Door articulation is a provisional horizontal X slide, not a measured hardware mechanism.

notes: Real Optima common platform: left circular vacuum chamber, grey cabinet and long inward-curving white front insert, right rotor staging pad and 15-inch landscape touch display.

XE and XPN facility photos show the same physical chassis; assets differ in actual model plate, simplified capability UI and XPN network port. We do not invent an unrelated enclosure to force a distinction.
Door is modeled as a provisional horizontal X slide over right pad, travel 0.40 m; this mechanism and travel need physical confirmation. Default is closed.
Schematic six-position rotor is optional and is not one of the specifically installed SW32Ti/SW41Ti/45Ti/SW60Ti/70Ti accessories. Rotor rotates about Z independently.
Facility #70/#71 text incorrectly repeats XPN description; model field and photos explicitly identify XE-100.
Not manufacturer CAD; UI is original simplified text and shapes, not reproduced proprietary interface.

review.method: Actual final-model render inspected beside facility/manufacturer reference; no photographic texture substitution
review.note: XE shared physical platform, curved front and top chamber/display reviewed; sliding door direction inferred and rotor is optional schematic.
review.final_review_note: Final evaluated-geometry render reviewed after curve-envelope correction and modifier-preserving export. Shapes compared with the previously inspected facility/manufacturer contact sheets.
review.approval_policy: Visual approval binds to the exact exported GLB (geometry, materials, hierarchy and animation); PNG date/render-time metadata may change without changing the reviewed model.

surface_check.method: Actual evaluated vertices to triangles in both directions, closed pose; Euclidean metres; all posed transforms independently checked

assembly.units: m at asset root; local translation units follow accumulated parent scale
assembly.axis_metadata: joint_axis uses Blender Z-up node local coordinates; glTF Y-up equivalent is [x,z,-y]
